klaim.bukti: We propose a new SfM technique that improves upon the state of the art to make a further step towards this ultimate goal. The full reconstruction pipeline is released to the public as an open-source implementation.
klaim.catatan: Kajian ini dikutip hanya sebagai alat rekonstruksi umum (SfM); abstrak mendukung sebutan itu. Bagian kalimat tentang evaluasi sintetis bukan atribusi kepada kajian ini.

klaim.bukti: Model-2 (MAPE of 23.45%) performed similarly to Model-3 (MAPE of 25.72%) and significantly better than Model-1 (MAPE of 35.59%).
klaim.catatan: Ketiga angka MAPE, tanaman, jumlah sisi, dan acuan panen per pohon sesuai abstrak. Abstrak menyatakan signifikansi hanya untuk Model-2 terhadap Model-1; keunggulan Model-3 atas Model-1 terbaca dari angkanya.

klaim.bukti: Model-2 (MAPE of 23.45%) performed similarly to Model-3 (MAPE of 25.72%) and significantly better than Model-1 (MAPE of 35.59%).
klaim.catatan: Model dua sisi (25,72%) tidak lebih rendah galatnya daripada model satu sisi (23,45%).

klaim.bukti: An outdoor machine vision system was developed with a low-cost Kinect V2 sensor to improve the accuracy of apple detection by filtering the background objects using depth features. [...] A depth threshold of 1.2 m was used to remove background.
klaim.catatan: Sensor Kinect V2, ambang 1,2 m, dan kebun fruiting-wall berkanopi rapat sesuai abstrak.

klaim.bukti: MobileNetV2 SSD, EfficientDet (Lite0, Lite1 and Lite2) and YOLOv5 (YOLOv5n, YOLOv5s and YOLOv5m) were simulated and compared [...] The models were trained on a dataset with four main ripeness classes: ripe, unripe, half-ripe, and over-ripe.
klaim.catatan: Perbandingan beberapa detektor pada empat kelas kematangan sesuai abstrak.

klaim.bukti: FFBs samples were harvested from the plantation and kept at room temperature overnight prior to being scanned by the thermal camera.
klaim.catatan: Pencitraan termal (FLIR E60) dilakukan pada tandan yang sudah dipanen; sesuai dengan keterangan "on harvested bunches".

klaim.bukti: To strengthen its resilience against occlusion, we have enhanced the tracking-by-detection algorithms with a multiple mapping algorithm.
klaim.catatan: Langkah multiple mapping untuk stroberi yang teroklusi sesuai abstrak.

klaim.bukti: Within prevalent tracking frameworks, our approach records a mere 6.7% relative counting error rate. Furthermore, the lowest error rates for the classes of ripe and unripe strawberries were 8.7% and 9.9%, respectively.
klaim.catatan: Ketiga angka sesuai. Abstrak menyebut 8,7% dan 9,9% sebagai galat terendah per kelas; kata "lowest" dapat ditambahkan bila diinginkan ketepatan penuh.

klaim.bukti: Furthermore, the lowest error rates for the classes of ripe and unripe strawberries were 8.7% and 9.9%, respectively.
klaim.catatan: Galat kelas matang (8,7%) lebih rendah daripada kelas mentah (9,9%) dan keduanya berbeda dari galat keseluruhan (6,7%). Perbandingan hanya memakai galat terendah tiap kelas; rincian per pelacak tidak ada di abstrak.
